verdict.rationale: Docs show real third-party integrations (Snyk security scanning, Jira Service Management, Rovo AI models) and mention connecting to 'other providers,' evidencing an extensible ecosystem, but there is no explicit mention of an app marketplace, an actions catalog, or a broad third-party app directory akin to a dedicated marketplace. Missing for 10: explicit Atlassian/Bitbucket Marketplace listing, breadth of third-party apps/actions catalog, and independent confirmation of marketplace usage.
